description.subtitle: T-shirt of the second equipment adidas of the selection of Germany 1990 - green
description.tagline: The return of a legendary team from Germany
description.intro: The adidas 2nd Germany 1990 T-shirt recovers one of the most iconic designs in the history of international football, inspired by the second equipment used by the German team in 1990.
key_benefits: Official retro design: Inspired by Germany's historic second gear 1990.
Vintage aesthetics: Classic geometric pattern with original adidas details.
Lightweight and comfortable fabric: Ideal for everyday use or to show off your football passion.
Cuello en pico: Acabado tradicional que refuerza el estilo retro.
Historical details: German Shield, adidas clover and iconic 3 bands.

key_benefits: Diseño retro oficial: Inspirado en la histórica segunda equipación de Alemania 1990.
Estética vintage: Patrón geométrico clásico con detalles adidas Originals.
Tejido ligero y cómodo: Ideal para uso diario o para lucir tu pasión futbolera.
